subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II report request + example telemetry sample asks
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@horizonhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + short list of artifacts and sample telemetry

Hi Sean,

We're starting our vendor assurance intake for Q1 procurement and need to collect your SOC 2 Type II report and a short set of supporting artifacts. Small ask list below — can you confirm which of these you can provide and an estimated delivery date? Also, please let us know the audit period covered by your Type II (start/end dates) and whether you can provide a bridge letter if the report period doesn't cover our contract go-live.

Horizon asks (priority):
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and auditor name
- Audit period covered (start/end)
- Bridge letter stating whether control environment materially changed since report period (template accepted)
- Short samples of telemetry/log extracts showing retention and redaction approach (sample CSV or anonymized logs; telemetry for inference requests: timestamp, model_variant, request_id, retention_flag)
- A one-page summary of control ownership for access management and logging (who to contact for evidence)

We aim to complete initial vendor review by Dec 8. If you can provide a short reply with attachments or a secure share link, that would be great.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Security & Vendor Risk
Horizon Health

P.S. If it's helpful, our auditor (TrustAssure) is cc'd — they may coordinate a limited evidence pull after the initial package is received.

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T13:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + short list of artifacts and sample telemetry

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide an initial intake package and a bridge-letter template. Quick answers below and a short delivery plan: 

What we can provide now (attached / in secure share):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — auditor: Brightway Assurance (will attach when permissions clear).
- Audit period covered: 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30.
- Bridge letter: we have a standard bridge-letter template (attached) that affirms no material changes to controls since the report period; we can issue a signed bridge letter if needed.
- Telemetry sample: anonymized CSV with column headers (timestamp, model_variant, request_id, retention_flag). See telemetry_sample.csv attached — this is redacted to remove PII.
- One-page control owner summary: included as the first tab in the SOC2_TypeII_Checklist.xlsx attachment.

Delivery plan / dates:
- Initial package (report + checklist + bridge template + telemetry sample): by 2026-11-30 EOD (I will upload to a secure Drive folder and share a link).
- If TrustAssure requests deeper artifacts (logs, config snapshots), we can accommodate a scoped evidence pull; please provide the control IDs and timebox.

One-line external reply templates you can use when routing to auditors or procurement: 
- "Received — we will upload Redwood's SOC 2 Type II, bridge template, and telemetry sample by 11/30 and will coordinate a scoped evidence pull if needed."
- "Confirming audit period: 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30; bridge letter can be issued on request."

Attachments included: SOC2_TypeII_Checklist.xlsx (control-owner map + minimal artifact index), bridge_letter_template.docx, telemetry_sample.csv. If you'd prefer SFTP or an encrypted transfer instead of Drive, tell us the preference and we'll follow that path.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Security & Compliance (Sales Enablement)
Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112

Thanks — Mark Cullen from TrustAssure here. Appreciate the quick turnaround plan. A couple of logistics notes from the auditor side: 

1) Bridge letter: standard template is fine; we'll accept a signed PDF.
2) Telemetry sample: the CSV you provided looks good. For our spot-check we may ask for a time-limited presigned link to a zipped extract (we will not request raw PII).
3) Evidence pull: please expect an auditor request for the following artifacts if Horizon proceeds to a deeper review (we'll keep it scoped):
   - Access control lists for the inference runtime (time-limited snapshot)
   - A sample of redaction scripts or procedures used at ingestion
   - Retention policy excerpt and corresponding S3 lifecycle config excerpt

DocuSign & scheduling: I'll send a DocuSign consent form for a scoped evidence pull. Once signed, we'll request presigned links with 48-hour access windows.

Next steps: Sean / Karthik — when you upload the initial package, please paste the Drive link here or reply with SFTP details. Elena — we'll coordinate timing with procurement once we receive the package.

Best,
Mark Cullen
